items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: See, he had a fellow by the name of Oil Umphrey. If you remember him. That's Willie Umphrey's brother.

ctx.x: Well I wasn't with him when he was on that boat going to Cincinnati. See, he had a fellow by the name of Oil Umphrey. If you remember him. That's Willie Umphrey's brother.
He's a trombone player. Well the reason why he left Sydney, not to say his musical ability, he's a circus man. He likes to follow the shows. He don't stay in one place, he likes to travel.
